title: No-Retune Enforcement
objective: Make post-output profile adjustment technically visible and testably forbidden: given a frozen profile's receipt and a proposed parameter set, detect ANY change to a frozen parameter, treat moving a label between training and holdout as a retune, route every change through claims.refuse_post_output_retuning(frozen=True) with a red RETUNED_AFTER_REVEAL verdict, and invalidate the holdout comparison after any mutation.

repository_truth.head: de620bb
reused_engine: cwatlas.r1082.claims.FROZEN_PARAMETERS + refuse_post_output_retuning; cwatlas.r1082.calibration_freeze receipt (parameters.frozen) - NOT reimplemented

claims.statement: detect_retune(before_receipt, after_params) diffs the seven frozen parameters, returns the specific parameter(s) that changed, treats moving a label between the training and holdout sets as a retune, and routes any change through claims.refuse_post_output_retuning(frozen=True), raising a RetuneError (an R1082ClaimError) with the RETUNED_AFTER_REVEAL verdict; a clean after-set returns a NO_RETUNE_DETECTED report and any change mints a new profile id.

negative_results: Every one of the seven frozen parameters (grid rotation, handedness, root feature, topology, tokenization, destination label split, epoch choice) is individually detected and refused when changed after the freeze.
Moving a label between the training and holdout sets is detected and refused as a retune even when no frozen parameter value changed - it re-partitions the sealed data.
Any frozen-parameter change or label move invalidates a prior holdout comparison (holdout_comparison_status returns INVALIDATED).
privacy_check: CLEAN - operates on frozen-parameter names and opaque label ids only; no private path literals, no personal identity tokens, no raw private narrative
